private_notes.observations: At $320, allocated hours fell from 377 to 345 as Dunmore Pike lowered its rate from $320 to $300. A rate cut may recover hours, but the added volume may not offset the lower margin.
private_notes.plan: Maintain $320 this quarter. Use the next allocation and rate card to assess whether Dunmore Pike's lower rate persists before changing ours.

private_notes.observations: At $315, our hours fell as Dunmore Pike cut its rate from $320 to $300. Our subsequent cut to $310 coincided with a further decline to 367 hours while Dunmore cut to $280. The other three firms remain at $320. Matching Dunmore’s cuts would substantially reduce our margin without clear evidence of a profit gain.
private_notes.plan: Return to $315 rather than pursue Dunmore’s price cuts. Monitor whether its rate stabilizes and reassess our rate against the resulting hours and profit.

private_notes.observations: At $320, allocated hours fell from 377 to 301 as competing rates declined, reducing quarterly profit from $45,223 to $36,097. Dunmore Pike is now at $280, and Arden & Cole at $310.
private_notes.plan: Reduce the rate to $300 to test whether increased allocation offsets the smaller margin. Evaluate the resulting hours and profit before making further changes.

private_notes.observations: At $320, our hours fell from 377 to 301 as Dunmore Pike cut its rate to $280 and Arden & Cole cut to $310. Quarterly profit fell to $36,097.
private_notes.plan: Cut modestly to $310 to test whether a more competitive rate recovers enough hours to improve profit. Avoid matching the deepest discount; reassess after observing the next allocation and rate card.

private_notes.observations: At $280 in Q18, profit rose to $53,556, the highest in the displayed history. Arden & Cole reduced its rate from $315 to $310; the other firms remained at $320.
private_notes.plan: Hold $280 to assess whether Q18's improvement persists with Arden & Cole at $310. Reconsider if allocated hours or competitors' rates change materially.

private_notes.observations: Dunmore Pike cut its rate from $320 to $280 over three quarters, while our hours fell from 377 to 301 at an unchanged $320 rate. Arden & Cole also reduced its rate to $310. Our quarterly profit has fallen to $36,097.
private_notes.plan: Reduce our rate moderately to regain hours without matching Dunmore Pike's steep discount. Compare the resulting profit and allocation with Q18 before deciding whether to adjust further.

private_notes.observations: At $315, allocated hours fell from 416 to 296 as competitors cut rates. Q19 profit was $34,041; the earlier $310 rate did not offset Dunmore's subsequent cut to $280.
private_notes.plan: Test $300 to recover hours while retaining a $100 margin. Compare realized profit with the $315 baseline and avoid chasing Dunmore's $280 rate without evidence it improves profit.

private_notes.observations: At $300 in Q19, we received 400 hours and earned $39,957. That is less profit than the $41,387 earned at $320 in Q17, but more than the $36,097 earned at $320 in Q18, when a rival had cut its rate to $280. Competitor rates remain below their earlier levels.
private_notes.plan: Test a modest increase to $305 to see whether the additional margin outweighs any loss of hours. Reassess after observing the allocation and next rate card.

private_notes.observations: At $310 in Q19, we received 327 hours and earned $35,985, roughly matching Q18 profit at $320. Several competitors also cut rates, so the effect of our own cut is unclear.
private_notes.plan: Hold $310 rather than chase the lowest-priced firm. Monitor whether hours stabilize and reconsider after another quarter of evidence.

private_notes.observations: At $280, profit was $53,556 in Q18 and $47,687 in Q19 after three competitors lowered their rates. Despite the decline, Q19 profit exceeded the sustained $45,223 earned at $320.
private_notes.plan: Hold at $280. The rate remains below every competitor's latest published rate, and the available results do not establish that another cut would improve profit.
